descriptions.blinds: Venetian blinds — vertical bands wipe together.
descriptions.boxopen: A rectangular iris opens from the centre.
descriptions.burn: The bright parts of the outgoing shot burn away first.
descriptions.checker: Checkerboard cells resolve in a scattered order.
descriptions.circleclose: An iris closes on the old clip.
descriptions.circlecrop: The frame pulls in to a circle and opens back out.
descriptions.circleopen: An iris opens from the centre to reveal the next clip.
descriptions.coverdown: The new clip slides in over the old one, downward.
descriptions.coverleft: The new clip slides in over the old one, leftward.
descriptions.coverright: The new clip slides in over the old one, rightward.
descriptions.coverup: The new clip slides in over the old one, upward.
descriptions.diagbl: A soft diagonal reveal from the bottom-left.
descriptions.diagbr: A soft diagonal reveal from the bottom-right.
descriptions.diagtl: A soft diagonal reveal from the top-left.
descriptions.diagtr: A soft diagonal reveal from the top-right.
descriptions.diamond: A diamond iris opens from the centre.
descriptions.dissolve: Grainy pixel dissolve with a film-lab feel.
descriptions.distance: The two frames blend by pixel distance — a soft morph.
descriptions.fade: Classic crossfade from one clip into the next.
descriptions.fadeblack: Dip through black — the cinematic scene change.
descriptions.fadefast: A crossfade that resolves early — snappy, almost a cut.
descriptions.fadegrays: Drains the colour, passes through grey, refills.
descriptions.fadeslow: A crossfade that lingers in the blend.
descriptions.fadewhite: Flash through white — bright and upbeat.
descriptions.glitch: Per-row digital tear — the TikTok glitch cut.
descriptions.hlslice: Horizontal slices peel away to the left.
descriptions.hlwind: Streaks smear the picture away to the left.
descriptions.horzclose: Two halves close in from the top and bottom.
descriptions.horzopen: The frame splits across the middle and opens outward.
descriptions.hrslice: Horizontal slices peel away to the right.
descriptions.hrwind: Streaks smear the picture away to the right.
descriptions.pixelize: Mosaic out, mosaic in — a digital feel.
descriptions.radial: A clock-hand sweep around the centre.
descriptions.rectcrop: The frame pulls in to a rectangle and opens back out.
descriptions.revealdown: The old clip slides away downward, revealing the new one.
descriptions.revealleft: The old clip slides away leftward, revealing the new one.
descriptions.revealright: The old clip slides away rightward, revealing the new one.
descriptions.revealup: The old clip slides away upward, revealing the new one.
descriptions.ripple: A ring ripples out from the centre.
descriptions.slidedown: The new clip pushes the old one down and out.
descriptions.slideleft: The new clip pushes the old one out to the left.
descriptions.slideright: The new clip pushes the old one out to the right.
descriptions.slideup: The new clip pushes the old one up and out.
descriptions.smoothleft: A soft-edged slide to the left.
descriptions.smoothright: A soft-edged slide to the right.
descriptions.spin: Spiral sweep — reads as rotation (alias of `spiral`).
descriptions.spiral: An angular sweep that rotates outward.
descriptions.squeezeh: The old clip squeezes flat sideways.
descriptions.squeezev: The old clip squeezes flat vertically.
descriptions.vdwind: Streaks smear the picture away downward.
descriptions.vertclose: Two halves close in from the sides.
descriptions.vertopen: The frame splits down the middle and opens outward.
descriptions.vuwind: Streaks smear the picture away upward.
descriptions.wave: A vertical wipe whose edge ripples as it crosses.
descriptions.whip: A whip pan to the left — a hard push with a motion-blur burst.
descriptions.whipdown: A whip pan downward with a motion-blur burst.
descriptions.whipright: A whip pan to the right with a motion-blur burst.
descriptions.whipup: A whip pan upward with a motion-blur burst.
descriptions.wipebl: A diagonal wipe towards the bottom-left corner.
descriptions.wipebr: A diagonal wipe towards the bottom-right corner.
descriptions.wipeleft: A hard edge wipes the new clip in from the right.
descriptions.wiperight: A hard edge wipes the new clip in from the left.
descriptions.wipetl: A diagonal wipe towards the top-left corner.
descriptions.wipetr: A diagonal wipe towards the top-right corner.
descriptions.zoomin: A punch-zoom into the next clip.
descriptions.zoomout: Iris-close. NOT a true zoom-out — the render engine cannot scale during a transition; this is the closest look it has.
